title: How Much is Left? LLMs Linearly Encode Their Remaining Output Length
abstract: arXiv:2607.05316v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language models generate tokens, without explicitly keeping track of the length of the generated text. This paper asks the question: can we estimate the number of tokens remaining in a generated response, using just a linear probe on the model's hidden states? Previous work on inference scheduling established that length is statistically predictable, using nonlinear methods. This paper contributes a linear representation method, using frozen hidden states of 7-8B instruction-tuned models, across seven datasets. We show that total completion length can be estimated, with performance stronger than statistical baselines, and stronger than the fair comparison to the prediction at the last token of the prompt. On the natural-language datasets, the probe's error lies between 0.57 and 0.88 of the statistical baseline's. translated_title: 还剩多少？大语言模型线性编码其剩余输出长度
translated_abstract: 大语言模型逐个生成token，并不会显式地追踪所生成文本的长度。本文提出了这样一个问题：我们能否仅通过对模型隐藏状态使用线性探针，来估计一个生成回答中剩余的token数量？先前关于推理调度的工作已经表明，文本长度在统计上是可预测的，但使用的是非线性方法。本文贡献了一种线性表示方法，使用7-8B指令微调模型的冻结隐藏状态，在七个数据集上进行了实验。我们证明，总的补全长度是可以被估计的，其性能优于统计基线，也优于与提示词最后一个token处预测结果的公平对比。在自然语言数据集上，该探针的误差介于统计基线误差的0.57到0.88之间。有趣的是，当出现撤回token（"Wait"）时，探针预测的长度会向上跳升超过70个token。
tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在隐藏状态中线性编码了剩余输出长度信息，仅需一个简单的线性探针即可准确预测生成回答还剩多少token，且当出现“Wait”等撤回token时预测长度会显著跳升。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that LLMs linearly encode their remaining output length in hidden states, so a simple linear probe can accurately predict how many tokens are left in a generated response, with predicted length jumping sharply when retraction tokens like "Wait" occur.
